displayDescription: Equal blocks stack from a common zero against one ruler, 1, 3, 5 and 8, under a shallow orthographic orbit.
styleRenderer: Three.js 0.187.0 (WebGLRenderer, OrthographicCamera, ShaderMaterial, EdgesGeometry) bundled locally to three.bundle.js
audioDescription: Silent preview; no music, effects or narration.
limitations: Blender not used, as instructed. Three.js and GSAP from the existing read-only node_modules are used; Three was bundled with local esbuild and nothing was installed.

Material is an illustrative approximation: flat-toned faces from one fixed key light in an sRGB ShaderMaterial, with a slight shift as the camera orbits. Contact shadows are pre-drawn radial textures; there is no real shadow casting or PBR.
An orthographic camera at fixed 20° elevation keeps every 1×1×1 unit the same height on screen; the orbit only changes the azimuth, from -34° to -16°.
Mapping: 1 count = one 1.0 world-unit cube stacked at a 1.0 pitch, the same as the ruler's tick spacing (56 px per unit).
No reviewed preview recipe was supplied (tech.preview_recipes is absent), so the preview shows the primary characteristic action.
